# #98 — P2: Add concurrency guard to deploy job

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-11T04:07:17Z
Updated: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z
Closed: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z

---

## Finding
The CI workflow has no `concurrency` block on the deploy job. Two rapid merges to main run parallel deploys that can race on git pull, bun install, migrations, and service restart.

## Evidence
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:61-104` — no concurrency block
- `claude-code-review.yml` already uses `concurrency` (lines 9-11), proving the pattern is known

## Risk
Parallel deploys can corrupt node_modules, apply migrations out of order, or restart the service mid-migration.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Add `concurrency: { group: deploy-production, cancel-in-progress: false }` so the second deploy waits
- Consider adding a pre-migration DB snapshot for rollback on failure

## Source
Post-speed-run review swarm, CI/CD reviewer, adversarial-verified.
